business_problem: ADEO, Europe's leading home improvement player, partnered with Google Cloud and CGI to optimize and deploy a store performance solution across its network. By migrating to BigQuery and GKE, the group provides 50,000 associates with high-performance data access at scale.
solution_summary: ADEO, Europe's leading home improvement player, partnered with Google Cloud and CGI to optimize and deploy a store performance solution across its network. By migrating to BigQuery and GKE, the group provides 50,000 associates with high-performance data access at scale. In April 2024, ADEO commissioned CGI, a historical partner of ADEO, to support the modernization of Booster's back-end. After conducting a benchmark, BigQuery proved to be the most interesting technical solution: the Google Cloud product had the advantage of being a stack already used by ADEO teams, reducing the learning curve and facilitating maintenance. The Google Cloud ecosystem also allows reliance on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), the standard application deployment platform at ADEO, ensuring harmonious integration with the group's other systems.
